_finding: The agent buy example is the one place where the guard's answer turns into a swap. It must quote only the contract the guard passed, refuse a price far from the issuer's reference, build a swap only for the user's own wallet and only to the aggregator's router, and build nothing unless a wallet was given.

mutations.name: a quote for another contract is accepted
mutations.expect: FAIL a quote for any other contract than the one checked is refused

mutations.name: the price is not held to the issuer's reference
mutations.expect: FAIL a quote 10% above the reference is refused

mutations.name: a swap to any router is accepted
mutations.expect: FAIL a built swap to any other contract than the router is refused

mutations.name: a swap is built without a wallet being given
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and without a wallet nothing is built

mutations.name: a paused token is quoted
mutations.expect: FAIL a paused token is refused before any quote

mutations.name: the look-alike is bought after the guard pointed elsewhere
mutations.expect: FAIL ...the quote is asked for the issuer's contract, never the look-alike

mutations.name: the link opens the contract the agent was handed, not the one checked
mutations.expect: FAIL after the quote, the link opens USDC -> the issuer's contract

mutations.name: a link is printed before the quote is held to the reference
mutations.find: if (!(tokens > 0)) return stop(1, 'refused', 'The quote gives nothing for the money. Nothing bought.')
mutations.replace:
print('link   ' + swapLink(address))
  if (!(tokens > 0)) return stop(1, 'refused', 'The quote gives nothing for the money. Nothing bought.')
mutations.expect: FAIL a refused quote gives no link

mutations.name: the swap pays out to someone other than the user
mutations.expect: FAIL with a wallet, the swap is built for that wallet as sender and recipient
